Anti-Aging Treatments in Kerala

Fine lines, a tired look, hollow under-eyes or a softer jawline? Ageing shows up differently on every face, so your treatment should too. Our doctors pinpoint what's actually changing, whether that's lines, volume, skin quality or sagging, and match it with the right non-surgical treatment: Botox, fillers, Profhilo, HIFU or PRP. The result is a fresher, rested look that's still completely you.

How Your Skin Ages, Decade by Decade

Tap your age group to see what's changing and what helps most right now.

What's happening: collagen production starts to slow from the mid-20s. Sun damage begins to build quietly.

  • Daily sunscreen and a good skincare routine
  • Baby Botox if you move your forehead a lot
  • HydraFacial or light peels for glow

  • Botox for expression lines
  • Profhilo or PRP to boost skin quality
  • Under-eye care for dark circles and hollows

Why we age

What Actually Causes Ageing?

Collagen and elastin loss
From the mid-20s, your skin makes about 1% less collagen each year. Skin gets thinner, less firm and more prone to lines.
Volume loss
Fat pads in the cheeks and temples shrink and slip, and bone slowly changes. This causes hollows, folds and a tired look.
Repeated expressions
Every frown, squint and raised brow folds the skin. Over the years, those folds become permanent lines.
Sun damage
UV is the biggest outside cause of ageing. It breaks down collagen and causes pigmentation, especially in Kerala's strong sun.
Lifestyle
Smoking, poor sleep, stress, sugar and rapid weight changes all speed up skin ageing.

At home

Slow Down Ageing Every Day

Sunscreen, every single day
SPF 30 or higher, rain or shine, reapplied outdoors. It's the most proven anti-ageing step there is.
A retinoid at night
Retinoids boost collagen and smooth texture. Start slowly, and ask us which strength suits your skin.
Moisturise and protect
A good moisturiser and an antioxidant serum like vitamin C support your skin barrier.
Sleep, food and no smoking
7 to 8 hours of sleep, enough protein, less sugar and no smoking all slow ageing.

Questions

Anti-Ageing Treatment FAQs

What are the best anti-ageing treatments?
It depends on what's bothering you. Botox is best for lines from movement, fillers for lost volume, Profhilo and PRP for skin quality, and HIFU for lifting sagging skin. Most people get the best result from a combination planned by a doctor.
At what age should I start anti-ageing treatments?
There's no fixed age. Many people start gentle, preventive treatments like baby Botox or skin boosters in their late 20s or 30s. Others start later to correct lines and sagging.
Will I look fake or frozen?
No. Our doctors aim for a fresher, rested look that's still you, with precise doses and subtle volume. You can always start small and build up.
Botox or fillers: which do I need?
Botox relaxes the muscles that cause expression lines. Fillers restore lost volume and hydration. They do different jobs, and many people benefit from both.
Which treatments have no downtime?
Botox, Profhilo and HIFU usually have little or no downtime. Fillers can cause a few days of mild swelling, and PRP with microneedling a day or two of redness.
How long do anti-ageing results last?
Botox lasts about 3 to 4 months, fillers 6 to 18 months, Profhilo about 6 months, and HIFU and PRP courses 12 to 18 months.
Are anti-ageing treatments safe for Indian skin?
Yes, when done by experienced doctors. Injectables and HIFU work under the skin, so the risk of pigmentation is low. We plan settings and aftercare carefully for brown skin.
Can I combine treatments?
Yes. Combining treatments, like Botox for lines, fillers for volume and HIFU for lift, often gives the most natural, complete result. Your doctor will plan the order and timing.
Do men get anti-ageing treatments?
Yes. Botox, HIFU for the jawline and skin boosters are popular with men.
How can I slow down ageing at home?
Daily sunscreen is the single most important step. Add a retinoid at night, a good moisturiser, enough sleep, no smoking and a protein-rich diet.
Where can I get anti-ageing treatments in Kerala?
Facelit offers anti-ageing treatments at our clinics in Trivandrum (Kowdiar), Karunagappally (Kollam) and Guruvayur (Thrissur). Some technologies, like HIFU, are at selected branches.
How much do anti-ageing treatments cost?
It depends on the treatment, the area and how much product or how many sessions you need. Book a consultation for a clear quote.
